full_judgment:
73. The testimony of PW1, the informant, in his examination-in-chief, has already been reproduced while stating the case of the prosecution. Therefore, I need not repeat the same. This PW in his cross-examination has stated that he was one of the Directors of Hamim Apparels Limited Garments Factory and his brother, AK Azad was its Managing Director. His elder brother, Md. Motaleeb Hossain was also one of the Directors. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that his deceased brother was also a Director. His (the PW) office was at New DOHS. The First Information Report (FIR) was typed at 12-00 O'clock at his office. He informed the duty Officer at the Police Station about the occurrence. Then said he telephoned the Deputy Commissioner of Police, North. He also informed the fact of death of his brother to the duty Officer at Cantonment Police Station at 8-30 am over telephone. The Police came to the place of occurrence on the basis of the said telephone call and stayed there upto 11 am. His other brothers and 150/200 people from the neighboring area also came at the rail line. He did not mark the neighborers who came there. Daroga of Cantonment Police Station prepared the inquest report, then said Daroga of Gulshan Police Station prepared the inquest report. He went to his residence along with the Police Officer present and narrated the incident to his parents. The DC North (Police) also came to their residence accompanied by 8/10 Police Officers. The Police Officers stayed at their house for about 10-15 minutes. He (the PW) meets his driver-Md Moquebul Hossain and his relative Md Abdul Halim. His driver, Md Moquebul Hossain, still serves under him (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “আমার ড্রাইভার মোঃ মকবুল ড্রাইভার হোসেন এবং আত্নীয় আঃ হালিম এদের সঙ্গে দেখা সাক্ষাত হয়। মকবুল ড্রাইভার এখনো আমার অধীন চাকুরী করে।” During investigation, he met the Investigation Officer, but he could not say whether his relative, Abdul Halim, was examined by him or not. Then said he did not take Halim to the Investigation Officer. The Police examined driver-Md Moquebul Hossain. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he got driver Md Moquebul Hossain arrested as he did not agree to depose falsely as per his tutoring. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he told his driver-Md Moquebul Hossain that he would not retain him in his service if he did not agree to give statement as tutored by him. He did not know whether the Investigation Officer of the case arrested driver-Md Moquebul Hossain or not. But he was taken by the Police for interrogation. He did not know whether Md Moquebul Hossain was taken to jail hajat in this case. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that after the occurrence, driver-Moquebul Hossain and relative Halim accompanied him and Moquebul informed him about the occurrence was a total lie. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that as driver-Moquebul and Halim did not agree to depose falsely, they were not cited in the case as witnesses. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that on 27-1-1997, accused-Biddut did not go to his house. He denied the defence suggestion that Biddut did not call for the deceased before Iftar. Then said his younger brother (the deceased) was not kidnapped, but was called away. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that during investigation, he neither told the fact that his brother was either abducted or called away. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he did not produce his driver-Moquebul and his relative Halim before the Investigation Officer. He admitted that he and his brother-AK Azad who was present in Court makes tadbir in the case. Daroga of Gulshan Police Station first came one day for investigation and arrested one accused, namely, Manik. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that subsequently, as per his choice, Daroga of Cantonment Police Station investigated the case. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he, by giving no confidence in the investigation by the Cantonment Police Station, took up the case to DB for investigation. DB Daroga-Humayun Kabir investigated the case for about 2(two) months. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that when the facts surfaced during investigation by the DB, investigation was taken to CID. Then the PW made a suo motu statement that on the assumption that Daroga of DB was not investigating the case properly, he filed application for changing the Investigation Officer. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that his elder brother, AK Azad Chowdhury made tadbir in the case and during investigation, he hid himself. He deals in garments business. The name of their Samity is BJME. At the time of occurrence, Kuddus shaheb was the president of the Samity and he had good relationship with his brother, AK Azad. He did not know whether his brother, AK Azad made tadbir in the case through said Kuddus shaheb. 

 80. PW 2, Md Kafiluddin, aged about 40 years, has stated in his examination-in-chief that he is a business man. On 27-1-1997, at about 4-30/5-00 pm, he had gone to Jahad Hotel at Mohakhali Bus Stand to buy Iftar. At that time, he met the deceased who gave him salam and on being asked where was he going? he (the deceased) replied that his friends invited him to Iftar to that place (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as সে বলে যে আমার বন্ধুরা ঐখানে ইফতারী দাওয়াত দিয়েছে।. There were other friends with the deceased and they were introduced to him. Then said he was introduced to Biddut, Manik and Titu and others as his friends. Subsequently, on 29-1-1997, when he went to the Garments, he heard that the dead body of the deceased was found by the side of the rail line. He identified the persons in the dock whose names he mentioned in his deposition (in the deposition sheet in Bangla, it has been recorded as “যাহাদের নাম বলিলাম তাহাকে ডকে আছে) 

 85. In cross-examination on behalf of accused-Karzon, the PW denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he was not Mahfuz Hossain Khan. He had no identity card at that time to show that he was Mahfuz Hossain Khan. He serves at J.A. Trading a C & F establishment. The proprietor of his office is Saidur Rahrnan. There are 7/8 employees in his office. He joined the office 1 (one) year before. In 1997, he was in the spoon factory of his brother at Nakhalpara, then said he used to supervise it. He used to come out of the factory at 4/5 pm, sometime the factory remained operational at night, but he did not stay in the factory if the factory used to be operational upto 8/10 pm. In 1997, he went near DOHS for playing. There is a play ground there. He went to DOHS at 4 pm, many persons play football there. He met Biddut and Roman at the field. There were many other boys in the field to play football, but he did not know the name of all. He went to Jahad Hotel at about 4:10 pm by the northern staircase. He went to the Hotel through the main road in front of the Hotel. The road passed through North to South, he went there from northern side, then said it was a long time, so he could not remember from which side he went to the Hotel. There was a bus stand in front of Jahad Hotel and it was Mohakhali Bus Stand. Hundreds of people remain there. He saw the accused at the entry point in front of Jahad Hotel. The path of entrance into the Hotel is in the middle. He had gone to that Hotel for the first time on that date, till the time of If tar, they remained in the ground floor. Jahad Hotel is a five storied one. They about 8 in number went to the roof, then said they went to the roof straightway, he could not remember whether there was any gate at the roof. There is gate at the backside of Jahad Hotel. The gate of the BTC is to the West of the said gate of the Hotel. He cannot say whether the Darwan of the BTC guards the gate day and night. He does not know whether 3000 employees of BTC pass through the said gate. There is a road on the West side of Jahad Hotel. There are many shops, houses on the North-South of Jahad Hotel and many people live there. The people move through the back side of Jahad Hotel, Rail line is by its side and train plies by this rail line. The staffs of BTC Company also use the road. The people always pass through this road. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he did not go to Jahad Hotel. He did not know whether there was tin over the roof. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he did not go to Jahad Hotel on 27 (nothing more mentioned) or he did not meet any of the accused or on the next day of the occurrence, he did not go to the place of occurrence to see the dead body. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he was an employee of the informant and that he did not know any of the accused. The CID examined him, but he could not remember the date of examination. Then said he was examined 6/7 months after the occurrence. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he was not examined and that every day, the informant brings him in Court or a Manager of the informant identified the accused to him or he was a fake witness or he deposed falsely as being tutored by the informant. 

 90. In cross-examination by Sarfaraj Uddin Karzon, the PW has stated that his village home is at village-Shwalpasena, Police Station and District-Jhalakathi. At the time of occurrence, Atique and Jahangir were the Managers of Jahad Hotel. He cannot say who the owner of Jahad Hotel is. Lucky Hotel was by the side of Jahad Hotel, but he cannot say the name of its owner. There are Kazi office, Courier Service and Glass House by the side of Lucky Hotel. Hotel Arman is on the South of Jahad Hotel, he does not know the name of its owner. The residence of Selim Khan is on the South of Hotel Arman. There are 5/6 shops in between Jahad Hotel and the residence of Selim Khan. In between these shops, there are motor garage and shop of rod and cement. There is a passenger shed, but he cannot say whether anything is sold there. He did not go to the 1st floor of Jahad Hotel. Generally, Jahad Hotel used to be closed at 10/10-30 pm. He cannot say the place where the staffs of the Hotel respond to their tall of nature. Front door of Jahad Hotel used to be locked and the back door of the Hotel used to be closed by latching. The rail gate is visible from Jahad Hotel. The line man always remains present at the rail gate for opening the line (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as "রেল গেটে লাইন খোলানোর জন্য সব সময় লাইন ম্যান থাকে।”). There is a Police Box at Mohakhali, the Police always remain present there. The Police Box is at the left-side at the entry point of Cantonment. He knows the American-British Tobacco Company which is 60 yards away from Jahad Hotel, but he does not know whether Darwan remains present at the gate of the Company day and night. There are roads on the West of Jahad Hotel as well as on the West of the rail line. Previously, there was no road on the West of Jahad Hotel, now there is a road. On the North, there is a gate of New DOHS, the Security Guards remain present there day and night, He knew that there was a family residence near Jahad Hotel, then said there might be 50/60 residences. The people of these residences and the shops pass along the road and when the Hotel remains closed, one has to go round about the way for a distance of km (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as "হোটেলে যখন বন্ধ ও তখন আধা কিলোমিটার ঘুরিয়া যাইতে হয়।”). The garage remains open. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that the garage remains closed in the night. On that date, the Hotel was opened at 3-10 pm (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “ঐ দিন বিকেল বেলা ৩-১০ টায় হোটেল খোলে”). He denied the defence suggestion that it was not fact that Jahangir and Manik were never the Managers of Jahad Hotel or he (the PW) never went to Jahad Hotel or he never went to Mohakhali or he never sold pan and cigarettes. Kazi office is at the first floor. There is no verandah at Jahad Hotel, there is a kitchen which remains under lock and key. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he comes to Court on every date or he has been tutored the name of the accused or he has deposed as tutored by the informant. 

 92. On behalf of accused-Shamsu Habib @ Biddut and Abu Rasel @ Rana, the cross-examination made on behalf of the other accused was adopted. On further cross-examination on behalf of the two accused, the PW has stated that he passed his matriculation examination in 1963. He came to Dhaka for the first time in January, 1995. He looked for the job, but did not get any job and then started to run a pan shop, then said he started to run the pan shop at the beginning of 1996. He has 4(four) sons and a daughter. His eldest son runs his business at Chittagong. The other 3 (three) sons are students. He has 5(five) bighas land. A son had fallen ill some days before and he had to be operated upon, then said about 6(six) months before. He did not see Daroga-Abdul Hai during this period. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he took money from informant-Ismail for operation of his son. Then said now, he did not run the business of cigarettes, he ran the pan-shop up to August, 1997 and while running pan shop, he had a rented house at Siddique Bazaar, he used to live there alone, then said he started living at the rented house at the last part of January and before that after closing the sale at the shop, he used to live in the Hotel. Then said he used to sleep with the staffs of Jahad Hotel. Jahad Hotel is a four storied building and he visited upto the ground floor, then said he did not go to the upper floor. He used to run his shop on the other side of the road in front of Hotel and in running the shop, the permission of the Hotel owner was not required. He has further stated that he used to stay inside the Hotel with the Hotel boys on the table, the Hotel boys also used to sleep on the table. On the date of occurrence, he kept fast and he took his Iftar at his shop. He did not know where the accused took their iftari. He did not know whether the accused kept fast. He cannot remember whether he told the Police that the accused took iftari in the Hotel. He cannot say on which date the Police went to Siddique Bazaar, then said he could not also remember whether it was 1997, then said in the last part of 1997 and he told the Police about the occurrence at that time and before that he told about the occurrence to the Hotel boy-Dulal, but could not remember the date, then said he told Dulal about the occurrence after 1/1½ months. He does not know the present whereabouts of Dulal. He did not say to the Police that he told about the occurrence to Dulal. He has further stated that he met Ismail shaheb for the first time on that very date and before that he did not know him. At Malibagh, he was taken to the 1st floor and before examining him, Ismail shaheb was told to go to the adjacent room and then he went there. He did not meet the Daroga before and he did not also tell him anything about the occurrence. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that before giving statement to the Daroga, he told about the occurrence to Ismail shaheb. The Daroga took 15 minutes time to examine him. Besides the accused mentioned by him in his examination-in-chief, there were 2/3 other persons along with them. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he did not see them before or he never had a pan shop. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he did not see the accused on the date of occurrence or they were not present at the time of buying cigarette or he deposed falsely. He has further stated that he heard that Ismail shaheb is a businessman. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he was an employee of the business establishment of Ismail shaheb or first he did not agree to depose or lastly he agreed to depose. 

 94. In further cross-examination on behalf of Biddut, this PW has stated that he knows Jahad Hotel, the other hotels and the shops around it. There is a restaurant in the ground floor of Jahad Hotel. He heard that there was a tin-shed at the top of Jahad Hotel and he did not go to its upper floors. He did not know Khokan Dutta, the Manager of Jahad Hotel. He does not know whether Khokan Dutta was the Manager of Jahad Hotel right from its beginning and till date. There were 2/3 pan shops around the place where he ran pan shop, but he did not know the name of the owners of those shops. He does not know whether someone named Abu Bakar had a pan shop in front of Jahad Hotel at the time of occurrence. He does not know said Abu Bakar. Then said, presently there might be a pan shop of Abu Bakar, but at the time of occurrence, there was no such shop. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that except the pan shop of Abu Bakar, no one had any pan shop in front of Jahad Hotel. There were 6 (six) staffs at the ground floor of the Hotel. They used to do their duties 24 hours. He does not know how many staffs were there at the upper floor of the Jahad Hotel. He does not also know where the staffs of the Hotel used to respond to their call of nature by the day (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “ষ্টাফরা দিনের বেলায় কোথায় বাথরুম ব্যবহার করতো জানি না।”). Mohakhali Bus Stand is 1/2km away from Jahad Hotel. He does not know the name of any shop owner or hotel owner or their employees around Jahad Hotel. He has further stated that he cannot remember the name of the owners and staffs of other hotels and establishments, namely: Lucky Hotel, Hotel Arman, Kazi Abbas, Glass House, New Lucky Motor, Rod and Cement shops (no name is mentioned) and Auto Parts at that place. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he looked like an industrialist, rather than a shop owner. His place of birth is at Shwalpasena, Jhalakathi under Banagram Union and Banagram is his polling center and he always casts his vote there. He got the summons from the Court 3(three) days before, then said he got the message over telephone that he has to depose, then again P.P. shaheb gave him the summons in front of the Court. In the summons of the witness, his village name has been written as Dariapur, Shwalpasena is 1(one) kilometer away from Dariapur. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that the address told by him was not his correct address. He has admitted that in Siddique Bazar, there is no road as Sharaswati Road. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that in order to depose in the case, he has used a fake address. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he deposes in Court as hired witness. He gave statements to the Investigation Officer on 22-12-1997. He did not tell the Investigation Officer that he had been running a pan-cigarettes shop for the last 3 (three) years near Mohakhali Bus Stand, but he said that he had been running his pan cigarettes shop for 2 (two) years. He has admitted that he did not tell the Daroga that after selling pan and cigarettes, he used to sleep at the verandah at Jahad Hotel. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he deposed in Court falsely as a hired witness being influenced by the informant. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he did not know any of the accused or he did not know their identity. When the Hotel remains closed, one has to go to the rail line by covering a distance of 1/2 kilometer. He did not tell either the Police of Cantonment Police Station or any other police as to who threw the dead body. 

 104. PW 11, Md Abdul Hai, Inspector of Police, has stated in his examination-in-chief that he was given the charge of investigation of the case on 13-3-1997 vide Memo No. মিএ/ঢাকা/পিডি-৩৪/৯৭/২০০১/১(৪) of the same date, CID, Sadar Daftar. On 15-3-1997, he collected the CD from AC DB Humayun Kabir and reviewed the docket and he found that the inquest report of the deceased was prepared on 28-1-1997 at 10-10 am by SI-Afsaruddin of Gulshan Police Station and he sent the dead body to the morgue at 11-05 am. On 28-1-1997, the Police of Gulshan Police Station arrested accused-Manik Ahmed. SI-Haniful Islam of Cantonment Police Station arrested accused: Tajuddin Ahmed Titu, Md Selim Khan, Abu Raihan Rana and Omar Faruque Rasel. Then said at the order of higher authority, he took up the investigation of the case on 25.03.1997 and visited the place of occurrence. He found the sketch map and the index prepared by the previous Investigation Officer correct. He himself did not prepare any sketch map and any index. He examined the witnesses and recorded their statements under 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (the Code). He took accused-Md Selim Khan (Md Selim Khan was arrested by the previous Investigation Officer on 15-3-1997) on remand and he interrogated him. Accused-Selim told him as to how he along with the other accused killed the deceased and he recorded the statement of Sam Khan. Selim Khan expressed his desire to give confessional statement before the Magistrate under section 164 of the Code. The accused arrested by him are on the dock. He submitted the charge sheet with Cantonment Police Station on 7-1-1998. 

 107. In cross-examination on behalf of accused-Karzon, the PW has stated that in the statement of witness-Kafiluddin, the name of accused-Karzon has not been mentioned. In the wireless message, it has been written that the accused (Karzon) is the proprietor of B & E Brick field. He examined the Manager of Jahad Hotel. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that as Manager, Khokan Dutta told that the allegation made in the occurrence was false, so he did not cite him as a witness in the case. The dead body of the deceased was lying behind Hotel Al-Noor. He has not cited anyone from that Hotel as witness, he has not also cited anyone as witness from the Continental Courier Service. The place where the dead body of the deceased was found is just by the side of the office of the Continental Courier Service. There were a few pan shops in front of Jahad Hotel, but he did not cite any pan shop owner as witness in the case. Gulshan Police Station is on the East of the Rail line, the dead body of the deceased was found under the jurisdiction of Cantonment Police Station. Darwan is posted at new DOHS gate; he examined the Darwan, but did not record his statements. He did not examine the night guard of the place where the dead body was found. There are many shops in the area where the dead body was found. In the night, people might sleep in those shops, then said those people moved along that road. There is restaurant in the ground floor in Jahad Hotel and its upper floors are residential Hotels. The Hotel remains closed in the night. The staircase of the residential Hotel is closed to the restaurant. He does not know whether the Manager sleeps in the staff room after locking the Hotel. He does not also know whether anyone sleeps in the staff room. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that the staffs do not sleep at the staff room. The office of America-British Tobacco Company is visible from the place where the dead body was found. He does not know whether the deceased had any ownership in the company of the informant, he did not see any paper in that respect. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that dispute was going on as to the ownership of the informant's company. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that none of the accused went to Jahad Hotel at the time of occurrence and none took any Iftar there. He does not know whether Jahad Hotel had any verandah. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that Abdus Sattar (PW 8) was not a pan shop owner. He does not know whether witness-Mahfuz (PW 2) is an employee of the informant or not. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he did not go to the place whether the dead body was found. None from the surrounding place where the dead body was found is a witness in the case. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that on the date of occurrence, accused Karzon was busy in paying labour payment at Narsingdi. He does not know whether accused-Karzon is a member of a business political family and a student of LLB first year. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that had he conducted the investigation into the case properly, the final report would have been submitted. He denied the defence suggestion that it was not a fact that he submitted false charge sheet sitting at CID office as dictated by the informant. 

 109. On behalf of accused-Karzon, Khokan Ranjan Dutta, aged about 50 years (as noted in the deposition sheet), was examined as DW1. He has stated in his examination-in-chief that he is the Manager of Jahad Hotel and he has been working since 1991. The Hotel is a five storied one, the 5th floor of the Hotel is a tinshed. There is a restaurant at the ground floor of the Hotel. From first floor to 4th floor, the Hotel is residential. Every day, 14/15 boarders reside in the Hotel. During the month of Ramadan, the restaurant is opened after evening. No arrangement is made for iftari in the Hotel. The restaurant remains open upto 10/11-30 pm. During seheri, the restaurant does not remain open. He works as the Manager of the Hotel sitting at the first floor. In January, 1997, he alone worked as the Manager of the Hotel. The Cook and the staff reside in the first floor of the Hotel at night. In the night, the Cook and the staff use the toilet in the first floor, no person resides in the kitchen room in the night. There is no verandah in the Hotel. There was no arrangement for the outsiders to reside in the Hotel without their order and presently, there is also no system to reside in the Hotel without their order. The distance of the footpath on the East of the Hotel is 4/5 feet. Since January, 1997 till date, no pan shop owner used to sit in between the space between their Hotel and the footpath and there is no pan shop now. On 27-1-1997, no Iftar party was held in the Hotel. He does not know the accused in the dock except Karzon. He knows accused-Karzon as he is the younger brother of the owner of the Hotel. Besides running hotel business, the PW also deals in brick kiln at Hatirdia Bazar under Monohardi Police Station, District-Narsingdi. Accused-Karzon and his elder brother used to run that brick kiln business. Accused-Karzon used to supervise the said brick kiln all most all the time. 

 110. In cross-examination by the prosecution, the PW has stated that he came to depose in favour of accused-Karzon. He did not give any statement to any Police Officer since 27-1-1997 and he did not also meet any Police Officer. He does not know anyone named Abu Bakar. He works with Thandu, Manager of Narsingdi brick kiln. Many labourers work there. He denied the prosecution suggestion that it was not a fact that accused-Karzon had no brick kiln at Hatirdia. Karzon has six other brothers, but Md Shahan Uddin is the owner of Jahad Hotel. That hotel business used to be conducted by Shahan Uddin and Salauddin. He does not know any friend of Karzon and cannot also tell their names. He cannot say what the numerical date of Ramadan was on 20-1-1997, then said it might be 15-20. At that time, the Cook and the boy-bearers were Muslims. His (the PW) family used to stay at his village-home at Netrakona. He did not take leave in the month of Ramadan. The accounts khata used to be written by both, the PW himself and the proprietor. Presently, there is no accounts khata. Food used to be supplied from breakfast to till night in the same routine except in the month of Ramadan. Food used to be served in the ground floor. The boy-bearers supply the food as per order of the Boarders. The restaurant was for the Muslims. In Dhaka, the Rojaders take iftari at the Hotel. He denied the prosecution suggestion that it was not a fact that at the time of occurrence, there were arrangements for pan, bidi and cigarettes in front of Hotel. He denied the prosecution suggestion that it was not a fact that since 1997, the pan shop owner used to sell pan in front of Hotel. He denied the prosecution suggestion that it was not a fact that he did not serve in the Hotel as Manager since 1997 and presently, he is not also the Manager of Jahad Hotel. He denied the prosecution suggestion that it was not a fact that accused-Karzon brought him to depose falsely in his favour. He denied the prosecution suggestion that it was not a fact that he had no relationship with Jahad Hotel or with the family of accused-Karzon. He denied the prosecution suggestion that it was not a fact that he had no connection with Jahad Hotel on 27-1-1997. 

 113. The chain of circumstances as found by the trial Court and the High Court Division to connect the accused with the killing of the deceased starts with the calling for the deceased by accused-Shamsu Habib Biddut to have Iftar as stated by PW 1, the informant. This PW stated in his examination-in-chief that on 27-1-1997, at about 4-30 pm, he accompanied with his relative, Md Halim went to his residence by his car along with driver-Md Moquebul Hossain from his head office at B-165, Road No. 33, New DOHS, Mohakhali to have Iftar. Just after a while, Biddut, a neighbourer, came to his residence and called for his younger brother, Reefat (the deceased) to have Iftar. His said younger brother did not come back home in the night for which he looked for him at many places. The PW telephoned to the residence of Biddut. The PW could not trace out the whereabouts of the deceased. In fact, this is the first part of the prosecution case as stated by PW 1. 

 117. The second part of the prosecution case stated by PW 1 is that on the next day, in the morning, driver-Md Moquebul Hossain came and informed him that 3 (three) youths who came by a sky coloured Honda Civic Car informed him (Moquebul Hossain) that the deceased was lying by the side of the rail line behind Jahad Hotel. It was 8 am, on hearing the said news, the PW along with driver-Md Moquebul Hossain went to the rail line behind Jahad Hotel and saw the deceased lying there with brain having come out from the head. The PW found bleeding injuries on the body of the deceased. He informed the Police Station (name of the Police Station cannot be found out as at the relevant portion of the deposition sheet, it is written (ছেড়া) and also the Deputy Commissioner of Police, North. At about 9-00.19-30 am, the Police came to the place of occurrence and prepared the list of alamats. The PW identified the dead body and then the same was taken to the morgue for post mortem. In respect of the second part of the prosecution case, the FIR story is that at about 8-00 am, his driver-Md Moquebul Hossain woke him up from sleep and informed him that 3 (three) youths who came on the road in front of his residence by a sky coloured Honda Civic Car informed him that the deceased was lying by' the side of the rail line behind Jahad Hotel and they went away towards the North. He immediately along with the driver went to that place and saw the deceased lying with injuries on his head caused by sharp weapon. Thus, from the testimony of PW 1 in his examination-in-chief as well as the facts stated in the FIR, it is clear that driver-Md Moquebul Hossain was present when accused-Biddut allegedly called for the deceased and it was he who, on the next day, gave the news to the PW as to the fact of lying of the dead body of the deceased by the side of the rail line behind Jahad Hotel hearing the information from 3 (three) youths who came by a Honda Civic Car. Not only that, driver-Md Moquebul Hossain also accompanied the PW to the rail line where the dead body was found lying. So, driver-Md Moquebul Hossain was the most vital and important witness to depose as to the both parts of the prosecution case stated by PW 1. of the two parts of the prosecution case stated by PW 1, the firgt part is very very crucial and relevant to connect the accused, particularly, Biddut with the killing of the deceased, because, i.e., the first link of the chain of circumstances of the killing 'of the deceased allegedly by the accused. 

 The second departure made by PW 1 from the FIR is that he did not say If tar party, but simply said to have Iftar. It is true that while cross-examining PW 1, his attention was not drawn to the fact that in the FIR, he stated that while accused Biddut allegedly called for the deceased immediate before Iftar, Md. Halim and Md. Moquebul Hossain were present with him, but he did not say so while he was examined, but failure on the part of the defence to draw his attention to that part of the story, would not, in anyhow, altogether, make the statement, made in the FIR, non-noticeable. Because departure or omission so made is not totally contradictory to the testimony of the PW in his examination-in-chief. PW 1 in his examination-in-chief very much mentioned the name of Md Halim and driver-Md. Moquebul Hossain who accompanied him by his car to his residence from his office on 27-1-1997, at 4-30 pm. PW 1 also stated that after some time of his arrival at his residence, Biddut, a neighborer, came and called for the deceased to have Iftar. In the context, it is necessary to state that though after receiving the news of the lying of the dead body at 8 am, the PW immediately went to the rail line where the dead body was lying, the FIR was lodged with Cantonment Police Station, at 15-35 hours, after discussion with his parents and brothers and sisters as stated by him in cross-examination. It may further be stated that the FIR was a written one typed in computer in his office by his typist, so it was a very well thought one. So the presence of Md Halim and Md Moquebul Hossain, when accused-Biddut allegedly called for the deceased to join an Iftar party can very well be presumed. Therefore, they were the most vital and important witnesses in the case to corroborate PW1 that accused-Biddut called for the deceased to have If tar. 

 128. PW 2 was examined in Court on 26-1-2002 and on that date, he was aged about 40 years (as recorded in the deposition sheet), i.e. on the date of occurrence on 27-1-1997, PW 2 was aged about 35 years, whereas the age of the deceased was about 24 years (as mentioned in the post mortem report) and the accused are allegedly the friends of the deceased. PW 2 in his examination-in-chief has stated that he is a business man. In cross-examination, he has stated that he deals in housing business and his office is on the West of Mohakhali. He stated that on 27-1-1997, at about 4-30 to 5-00 pm, he had gone to Jahad Hotel at Mohakhali Bus Stand to buy Iftar. At that time, he met the deceased there who gave him salam and on being asked where he was going, he (the deceased) replied that his friends invited him to Iftar at that place (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “সে বলে যে আমার বন্ধুরা ঐ খানে ইফতারী দাওয়াত দিয়েছে।”). There were other friends with the deceased and they were introduced to him. Then said Biddut, Manik, Titu and others were introduced to him as his friends. 

 129. Now, if we consider the evidence of PW 2 along with the statements made in the FIR and the deposition of PW 1, the presence of PW2 at 4-30/5-00 pm for purchasing iftari from Jahad Hotel becomes absolutely doubtful. In the FIR, the informant categorically stated that he started from his office at Mohakhali at 4-30 pm and Biddut called for his brother just before the Iftar (relevant portion of the FIR has been quoted earlier yet, we consider it very pertinent to repeat it here; in the FIR it has been stated “গতকাল ইফতারীর ঠিক পূর্ব মুহুর্তে আমার কনিষ্ঠ ভাই মোঃ নুরুল ইসলাম ওরফে রিফাতকে ইফতার পাটির্তে যাইবে বলিয়া আমার নিকট হইতে অনুমতি নিয়া ডাকিয়া লইয়া যায়। so if accused-Biddut called for the deceased just before iftar then the question of meeting PW2 with the deceased at 4-30/5-00 pm at Jahad Hotel does not arise at all. PW 1 deviating from the FIR story, stated in his examination-in-chief that on 27-1-1997, at about 4-30 pm, he along with his relative-Md Halim went to his residence by his car with driver-Md Moquebul Hossain from his head office at B#165, Road No. 23, New DOHS, Mohakhali for Iftar. Just after a while, Biddut, a neighbourer, came to his residence and called for his younger brother, Reefat to have If tar (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as, “ বাসায় আসার কিছুক্ষণ পরেই আমাদের পাশের বাড়ীর বিদ্যুত আসে। আমার ছোট ভাই রিফাতকে ইফতারের কথা বলে ডেকে নিয়ে যায়।”) then time for calling by Biddut must be around 4-35 or 4-40 or may be 5-00 pm. If the testimony of PW 2 is to be believed that he went to buy iftar at Jahad Hotel at Mohakhali Bus Stand, surely he must have gone there much earlier, because after buying iftar he must go to his residence. In this regard, we may profitabably refer to his testimony in cross-examination that he used to take iftar at his residence; there are four members in his residence (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “আমি বাসায় ইফতারি করিতাম। বাসায় সদস্য সংখ্যা ৪ জন।. So, the question of meeting the deceased at 4:30-5-00 pm, at Jahad Hotel, while he had allegedly gone there to buy If tar, does not arise at all. Further from the FIR and the testimony of PW 1, it is clear that the deceased was called for by accused-Biddut only, so the question of introduction of Manik, Titu along with Biddut and other friends to PW 2 does not also arise at all. More so, because of the age difference between the PW and the accused and he having a family, it does not appear to be natural that before Iftar time, the deceased would introduce his friends to PW 2. The prosecution story is that Iftar party was arranged at Jahad Hotel on 27-1-1997 as stated by PW 3. PW 3 has stated in his examination-in-chief that on 26-1-1991, at 4-00 pm, when he had gone near Mohakhali DOHS and met Biddut, Roman and others, Biddut invited him to have Iftar at Jahad Hotel, at Mohakhali and accordingly, he went there on 27-1-1997, in the evening, Biddut was not supposed to go to the residence of the deceased to call for the deceased in any case after 4:30 pm to invite him to have Iftar and then again his friends being invited to the Iftar party would stand at Mohakhali Bus Stand and then to meet PW2 there. So, for no logic, the deceased was supposed to meet PW 2 at Jahad Hotel at Mohakhali Bus Stand when he allegedly went there for buying If tar. Therefore, PW2 does not appear to me to be a natural and competent witness to depose that he saw the deceased with accused-Biddut, Manik, Titu and others on 27-1-1997, at 4:30/5:00 pm, at Jahad Hotel whenhe had gone there to buy Iftar to show the second link of the chain of circumstances to connect the accused with the killing of the deceased. 

 131. Accepting PW 2 as a natural witness for argument's sake, let us consider how far his testimony of seeing the deceased with accused-Biddut, Manik and Titu on 29-1-1997, at 4-30-5-00 pm, at Jahad Hotel is acceptable to connect them and the other accused as a second link of the chain of circumstances leading to the killing of the deceased. This PW in his examination-in-chief has stated that subsequently, on 29-1-1997, when he went to the Garments, he heard that the dead body of the deceased was found by the side of the rail line, but he did not disclose the fact of seeing the deceased in the company of Biddut, Manik and Titu and also the fact that the deceased telling him that his friends invited him to have Iftar at Jahad Hotel till he was examined by the Investigation Officer on 17-8-1997 and no explanation whatsoever has been given for non-disclosure of the facts which he knew so long, though he admitted that he knew Cantonment Police Station, but he did not go to the Police Station to tell about occurrence and the deceased respected him like elder brother. 

 132. Though PW 2 stated in his examination-in-chief that he was a business-man, he, in cross-examination, made contradictory statement as to the nature of his business; first he said he dealt in housing business; then said he hired the garments on the West of his residence on the West of the road, the name of the garments was Modern Garments. His relationship with A.K. Azad was neither good nor bad, but he knew that he was the brother of the deceased. He regularly went to his residence and office even after he had heard that the dead body of the deceased was found (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “এই রিফাতের লাশ পাওয়া গিয়াছে শোনার পরেও নিয়মিত বাসায় ও অফিসে গিয়েছি।”). Police examined him 7/8 months after the dead body had been found. Then said the Police called him at CID office after 8/9 months of the occurrence and during this period, the Police neither called him nor examined him. He met the informant oft and often who was his tenant (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “সংবাদ দাতার সাথে মাঝে মাঝে আমার দেখা সাক্ষাত হইয়াছে সে আমার ভাড়াটিয়া”।. He came to know about the occurrrence for the first time, on 29-1-1997, while he was going to the garments. This PW admitted that as Reefat was a big bariwala, so he was known to him, but his friends were not known to him (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “যেহেতু রিফাত বড় বাড়ী ওয়ালা সেই হেতু সে আমার পরিচিত। রিফাতের বন্ধুরা আমার পরিচিত নয়।”) 

 137. Be that as it may, for argument's sake, if PW 3 is accepted as Mahfuz Hossain of the charge sheet whether his testimony can be accepted to establish the 3rd link of the chain of circumstances to connect the accused with the killing of the deceased applying the theory of last seen. The PW in his examination-in-chief stated that on 26-1-1997, at 4-00 pm, he went near Mohakhali, DOHS where he met Biddut, Roman and others. Biddut invited him to Iftar at Jahad Hotel (no date mentioned), Mohakhali and accordingly, he, on 27-1-1997, in the evening, went there. In the Hotel, he saw Roman, Biddut, Manik, Selim, Razan and Reefat (the deceased). Sometime thereafter, Rana joined them. At the time of Iftar, all went to the roof of Jahad Hotel. Just immediate before Iftar, the hotel boy served up Iftar and all of them took Iftar. Some of them took phensidyl during Iftar, but he (the PW), Manik and Roman did not take phensidyl. After gossiping for about one hour, two unknown persons came to Roman and Biddut with the bottle of foreign liquor and 8/10 bears. All present, then said many had liquor and bear. Sometime thereafter, accused-Selim told that his mother, sister-in-law and others had gone to Brahmanbaria and his house was empty and proposed to go to his house for gossiping and then all of them went to the house of Selim. They heard song at the deck-set at the residence of Selim. At one stage, Roman became agitated and asked the deceased why he mixed with his (Roman's) sister. Then the deceased replied that he should ask his sister why she mixed with him. Biddut being agitated gave a few fist blows and kick on the deceased. At the intervention of all present there, the quarrel came to an end. Sometime thereafter, Roman, Biddut and the said two unknown persons went out of the house and the others including the PW continued their gossiping. After a few while, Roman, Biddut and the two unknown persons came back to Selim's house. At about 10 pm, he (the PW) went to his house keeping all others at the residence of Selim (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as“রাত আনুমানিক ১০ টার সময় সবাইকে সেলিমের বাসায় রাখিয়া আমার বাসায় চলিয়া যাই।”). On the next day, i.e. 28-1-1997, at about 9 am, he came to know from the people that a dead body was lying by the side of rail line behind Jahad Hotel. He went near the rail line to see the dead body and could recognise the dead body as that of Reefat. Then he came back to his house. He identified Biddut, Roman, Manik, Selim and Karzon in the dock. 

 139. The High Court Division did not find any fault with the PW in not telling anything to anyone at the time of seeing the dead body on the solitary statement made by this PW in cross-examination made on behalf of accused-Shamsu Habib Biddut, Abu Raihan @ Rana and Selim Khan to the effect “ঐ সময় ভয়ে কারও কাছে কিছু বলি নাই।” relying on the observation made in the case of Md Mahmudul Islam © Ratan vs State, 5 MLR (AD) 334, wherein PW 12 did not tell the names of assailants to the Investigation Officer being afraid of his life and he disclosed their names in his belated statement in Court. The High Court Division relied on the observations made in that case by Latifur Rahman, CJ to the effect "Today the father is not deposing when his son was killed before him, the wife is not deposing when her husband was killed before her and the relations are compromising cases of grave nature for maintaining security of their future life." Relying on the observation made by Latifur Rahman, CJ, the High Court Division (before considering the evidence of PW 8) also observed that "It is in the evidence of PWs 2, 3 and 8 that they did not go to the Cantonment Police Station to inform the Police of the occurrence. This conduct of the said witnesses is not at all unusual in view of the prevailing law and order situation, particularly, in Dhaka where sometime murders have been committed in broad day light without resistance. Again none is dared to tell the truth for fear of his life as per the observations made by the then learned Chief Justice of Bangladesh." (I shall discuss the testimony of PW 8 later on and see whether he at all gave an explanation for not going to Cantonment Police Station to tell what he knew about the occurrence). But I say with all emphasis and certainty that PW 2 did not say a word as to why he did not go to Cantonment Police Station or did not tell anything to the Police till 17-8-1997 when he was examined by PW 11, so the High Court Division was absolutely wrong in making the observation that the conduct of PWs 2, 3 and 8 in not going to Cantonment Police Station to inform the Police "of the occurrence" was not at all unusual in view of the prevailing law and order situation. The one line testimony of PW 3 as quoted hereinbefore even if accepted to be true, that refers to the time only, when he saw the dead body by the side of rail line, not of the subsequent time. Because, during the cross-examination by the other accused, the PW stated that he disclosed the occurrence to Ismail, the informant and his other relatives. At the risk of repetition, it is stated that it is nowhere the case of the prosecution that any of the accused ever threatened PW3 to disclose the fact which he knew about the occurrence either to the Police or to any one else till he was examined by the last Investigation Officer (PW 11) on 17-8-1997. PW 3 did not also say that he did not say anything about the occurrence out of fear of life. The Investigation Officer did not also say anything in the charge sheet or in his deposition that he could not examine the PW earlier and record his statement earlier than 17-8-1997 as the PW did not come forward to give statement or the PW was not available for examination out of fear of life. In this regard, I would like to refer to the facts of the case of Md Mahmudul Islam (supra) where Latifur Rahman, CJ made the observations as quoted hereinbefore and relied upon by the High Court Division. In that case, two persons were murdered, another was attempted to be murdered at two different places in broad day light, the accused were armed with Cut Rifle, Revolver, Pipe Gun, Chapati, Knives and Hockey Stick. PW12 Bidhu Bhusan Saha who saw the occurrence of killing Munir from his Balcony while deposed in Court stated that he did not disclose the names of the accused to the Police Officer being afraid of his life and told the Investigation Officer that "Whatever he had to say he would disclose before the Court of law." PW 24, Tofazzal Hossain, Investigation Officer, also stated that PW 12 declined to disclose in details everything to him. Under that circumstances, this Court accepted the late disclosure of the name of the assailants by PW 12 and Latifur Rahman, CJ who spoke for the Court made the observations. In that case, the explanation given by PW 12 in not disclosing the facts in detail to the Investigation Officer was accepted and the testimony of PW 12 was relied upon which the High Court Division rejected on the ground that he did not disclose the facts to the Investigation Officer. But the facts of the instant case are all together different. PW 3 was not an eye witness to the occurrence; he allegedly went to the residence of Selim Khan after taking If tar at Jahad Hotel. He has stated that at one stage of the gossiping and hearing the song at the Deck set at the house of Selim Khan, Roman became agitated and asked the deceased why he mixed with his (Roman's) sister. Then the deceased replied that he should ask his sister why she mixed with him. Biddut being agitated gave a few fist blows and kick on the deceased. At the intervention of all present there, the quarrel came to an end. This PW did not at all say that he saw any weapon or arms there. It is also noteworthy that PC PR of all the accused are nil and none of the witnesses including the two Investigation Officers (PWs 9 and 11) who were examined in the case said a word that the accused were men of dangerous character or had bad reputation or they were in any way involved with any criminal activities not to speak of committing any heinous offence including murder, so PW 3 had no reason to be afraid of the accused not to disclose to the Police earlier what he knew about the occurrence. It is also very significant to state that in the instant case, the PW stated the fact to the Police while he was examined on 17-8-1997 and he did not give any explanation whatsoever for his non-disclosure of the facts of the occurrence after so much delay. It is true that section 157 of the Evidence Act stipulates that the statement of a fact by a witness should be made to the competent authority at or near the time when the fact to which the statement relates took place. What should be the span of time of making such statement by a witness is basically a question of fact and no hard and fast rule can be laid down in that regard. It would vary from case to case and upon the peculiar circumstances of a particular case under which delay in recording the statement of a witness about the fact which he knew or knows might be caused. And mere delay in recording the statement of a witness by the investigation officer cannot be the sole ground to discard his evidence, if he withstands the test of cross-examination and thus appears to be truthful witness. In the facts and circumstances of the instant case, the delay of examination of the PW by the Investigation Officer after 7(seven) months and the disclosure of facts of the occurrence by the PW was fatal and it creates a doubt about the veracity of the testimony of PW 3 (reasons already given earlier). 

 140. In accepting PW 3 as the star witness, the High Court Division also failed to consider that immediate after saying that “ঐ সময় ভয়ে কারও কাছে কিছু বলি নাই।”  he told that he told about the occurrence to the relative of the deceased on some occasions in between the period from the date of occurrence till his going to the CID office and that after 5 months of the occurrence, he himself told about the occurrence to Ismail shaheb (the informant) at his Garments at Rasulbag and thereby he gave a go-bye to his earlier statement that he did not say about the occurrence out of fear. The High Court Division also failed to consider that in cross-examination made by accused-Roman, the PW clearly stated that he did not tell about the occurrence to the Police on that date after he had seen and recognized the dead body. He did not go to the Cantonment Police Station and tell about the fact of seeing the dead body or as to the fact of his knowledge about the occurrence. He repeated that before he gave statement to the CID, he told the incident to Ismail shaheb in the factory where he served in presence of his friends. The High Court Division also failed to consider the stark difference between the instant case and the case of Md Mahmudul Islam (supra) that in the reported case PW 12 for the first time disclosed the name of the accused in Court saying that he did not disclose the occurrence in detail to the Investigation Officer about being afraid of his life and the reason for fear of life was obvious in view of the nature of the murders that took place in that case, but in the instant case, PW 3 disclosed the facts to the Investigation Officer in detail, but after 7(seven) months and without any explanation whatsoever in the examination-in-chief. The one line explanation given by PW3 as relied upon by the High Court Division discussed hereinbef ore was given in cross-examination. If such an explanation for the belated disclosure of the knowledge of the commission of offence of the so-called fear of life is easily accepted as an explanation in a case punishable with death, I am afraid this will lead  to a dangerous situation endangering the administration of criminal justice giving wide scope of concoctions and false implications of any one in a criminal case (emphasis supplied). In the facts and circumstances of the case the belated disclosure of facts of the occurrence was a serious infirmity striking at the credibility of the testimony of PW 3. The High Court Division relied upon the observations made by Latifur Rahman, CJ on total non-application of mind to the facts on which the observations were made. 

 144. Inspite of the fact that PW8 cannot be accepted as a natural and competent witness to depose in the case in respect of the occurrence, let us examine how far his testimony can be accepted to establish the last link of the chain of circumstances to connect the accused with killing the deceased. This PW in his examination-in-chief stated that at the time of occurrence, he was running a business of pan, cigarettes in a shop by the side of Mohakhali Bus Stand. On 27-1-1997, he was at his shop. At about 4/4-10 pm, he saw Biddut, Reefat(the deceased), Titu, Roman Rasel, Manik Karzon, Rana and others entering into Jahad Hotel and coming out after Iftar at 7 pm. They (the named persons) purchased two packets of Benson cigarettes from his shop and then entered into the house of Selim Khan. After selling goods at his shop at about 10/10-10 pm, he went to sleep at Jahad Hotel at about 3 o' clock in the night, when he woke up to take seheri and went by the side of the line to make water (it would be rail line), he saw accused Biddut, Selim Khan, Roman Rasel, Rana, Karzon and others taking a person by holding to the South. After going a while, they threw the man on the rail line. In the morning of the next day, when the people gathered by the side of the rail line, he also went there and could identify the dead body as that of the deceased. He further stated that except Rana all are present in the dock and he identified them. 

 148. The last but not the least absurdity in the story of PW 8 is that at about 3 O'clock, in the night, when he woke up to take sehari and went to make water by the side of the rail line, he saw accused-Biddut, Selim Khan, Roman, Rasel, Rana, Karzon and others taking a person by holding to the South and after going a while they threw the man on the East of the rail line. My reasons in holding so are (a) PW 8 in his cross-examination stated that he could not say where the Hotel staffs used to respond to their call of nature (হোটেল ষ্টাফদের কোথায় বাথরুম করে তাহা বলিতে পারিব না।” (b) then said in the ground floor, there were six staffs who used to do their duty 24 hours (he could not say how many staffs were in the upper floors), but he could not say where they used to respond to their call of nature during day time, (c) he claimed that after selling pan cigarettes in his pan shop, he used to sleep at Jahad Hotel with the hotel boys, but he could not say where the staffs used to respond to their call of nature, (d) it is also inconceivable that in a hotel where so many people are employed, there will be no bath room for their use and if the PW really used to stay in the Hotel in the night with the hotel boys after selling goods at his pan shop as claimed by him, he would not be allowed to use the bathroom used by the staffs and that at the dead of night, i.e. at 3 o' clock as stated by him, he would have to go by the side of the rail line to make water, (e) the Investigation Officer stated in his cross-examination that “উক্ত ছাত্তার মহাখালীতে জাহাদ হোটেলের সামনে দোকানদারী করিত সেই মর্মে কোন প্রমান নাই।” PW8 admitted in his cross-examination পান সিগারেট বিক্রয় করে তিনি রাত্রে জাহাদ হোটেলের বারান্দায় ঘুমাইতেন এই কথা দারোগাকে বলেন নাই।” whereas PW11, Investigation Officer in his cross-examination categorically stated that “তিনি পান সিগারেট বিক্রয় করে জাহাদ হোটেলের বারান্দায় ঘুমাইতেন”. Unfortunately, the High Court Division without considering those very apparent inherent absurdity in the testimony of PW8 accepted his version as to his seeing the accused throwing a dead body by the side of the rail line relying on a sentence in his cross-examination by one of the accused that “জাহাদ হোটেলের পিছনের দরজায় খিল দেয় সামনের দরজায় তালা দেয়।” on the argument that the PW could go to make water by the back door of the Hotel by opening its latch without considering the normal conduct of human behaviours and common course of businesses that leaving aside the bathroom in the Hotel why PW 8 should choose the rail line to make water. In this regard, the High Court Division failed to consider the evidence of DW 1, the Manager of the Hotel that the cook and the staffs used to live in the first floor of the Hotel and they used the toilet in the first floor which is quite natural because the cook and the staffs who work in the Hotel are supposed to stay in the hotel and it is inconceivable that there would be no bathroom and toilet in the Hotel for their use and that a person who sleeps in the Hotel would have to go outside the Hotel to make water by the side of rail line. In this regard, it is necessary to state that DW 1 claimed that he is the Manager of the Hotel since 1991, he categorically stated that there was no verandah in the Hotel and except the boarders there was no arrangement of the outsiders to live in the Hotel and presently, there is no such arrangement as well. Whereas PW 11 stated in his cross-examination that PW8 used to sleep in Verandah of Jahad Hotel after selling pan cigarettes. DW1 categorically stated that no pan shop used to sit on the footpath in between the Hotel and the footpath. He further stated that on 27-1-1997 no Iftar party was held in the Hotel and that no Iftar is arranged in the Hotel. This DW was disbelieved by the High Court Division on the ground that it was not believable that in a Hotel, there would be no arrangement for Iftar where the Boarders used to stay, although by cross-examining him, the prosecution could not shake his evidence that he was the manager of the Hotel and that no Iftar was prepared in the Hotel. He was disbelieved by the High Court Division on the further ground that accused Karzon is the younger brother of the owner of the Hotel, which cannot be a reason to disbelieve DW 1 when credibility of his testimony in examination-in-chief could not be impeached or shaken by the prosecution by cross-examining him. It is also very significant to state that no suggestion was given to DW 1 that there was no bathroom or toilet in the Hotel for the use of the staffs and PW8 also did not make any positive assertion either in his examination-in-chief or in cross-examination that there was bathroom or toilet in the Hotel. 

 156. In the facts and circumstances of the case, the timing of calling for the deceased by accused-Biddut as stated by PW 1, the meeting of PW 2 with the deceased, Biddut and Manik at Jahad Hotel and aslso PW 3 at the same hotel with the accused and the deceased, seeing of the accused entering into Jahad Hotel by PW 8 is very crucial and important. One of the links of the chain of circumstances to connect accused-Biddut, Manik and Titu is the testimony of PW 2. These 4 (three) PWs did not give uniform time as to the fact of calling for the deceased by accused-Biddut and subsequent meeting of the deceased and the other accused with PWs 2 and 3 and seeing of their entering into the hotel by PW 8. At the risk of repetition, it is stated that according to the FIR, Biddut called for the deceased just immediate before If tar (the relevant portion of the FIR has been quoted earlier) to join an Iftar party. It may be further stated that in the FIR, the name of Jahad Hotel was not mentioned. PW1 in his examination-in-chief stated that he reached his residence at Mohakhali at 4-30 pm and sometime thereafter (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “কিছুক্ষণ পরেই” Biddut came and called for the deceased to have Iftar, so surely Biddut went to his residence after 4-30 pm and it may be around 4-35 or 4-40 or 5-00, whereas, PW 2, who claimed to have met Biddut at Jahad Hotel where he had allegedly gone to buy Iftar stated that he went to Jahad Hotel at 4-30/5 pm and he met the deceased there along with his friends: Biddut, Manik, Titu and others who were introduced to him; PW 3 stated in his examination-in-chief that he went to Jahad Hotel on 27-1-1997 in the evening (no specific hour is mentioned) and saw the deceased along with Roman, Biddut, Manik, Selim, Rajon and others. But in cross-examination, PW 3 categorically stated that he went to the Hotel at 4-10 am (in the deposition sheet, in Bangla, it has been recorded as “অনুমান ৪ঃ১০ টায় জাহাদ হোটেলের উত্তর সিড়ি দিয়া উঠি। হোটেলের সামনে মেইন রাস্তা সেই রাস্তায় হোটেলে যাই।” PW 8 in his examination-in-chief stated that on 27-1-1997, while he was in his so-called pan shop at about 4-00/4-10 pm, he saw accused-Biddut, the deceased, Titu, Roman Rasel, Manik Karzon, Rana and others entering into Jahad Hotel. So, if the testimonies of PWs 3 and 8 are accepted then the evidence of PW 1 as to the time of calling for the deceased by accused-Biddut and their meeting with PW 2 at 4-30/5-00 becomes false and this creates a serious doubt about the first link of chain as well as the 2nd link of chain as told by PWs 1, 2, 3 and 8 respectively. This doubt becomes more solid due to the fact that PW 1 did not tell the name of Biddut to the Duty Officer of Gulshan Police Station at the time of giving the telephone message about the occurrence though he was asked for. The discrepancy as to the timing of calling for the deceased by accused-Biddut and then his (the deceased) meeting with PWs 2 and 3 on the date of occurrence at Jahad Hotel and others and seeing of the deceased entering into the Hotel by PW 8 has been clearly found by the High Court Division, but unfortunately, it did not give any benefit of such discrepancy to the defence on the view that the broad feature of the testimonies of PWs 1, 2 and 3 related to holding of Iftar party at Jahad Hotel, the discrepancy about the timing of arrival of the participants as evident in the testimony of the PWs was ignorable and was minor discrepancy which cannot be treated as fatal for the prosecution. I consider it important to quote the entire finding of the High Court Division in that regard which is as follows: 

 158. The investigation into the case was held in a perfunctory manner is apparent from the fact that PWs 3 and 8 in their cross-examination categorically stated that there are shops, houses and other business establishment around Jahad Hotel, but the Investigation Officer did not examine any one of them. Admittedly, none of the establishments around Jahad Hotel and around the place where the dead body was found and also of the residence of Selim Khan where the deceased was allegedly killed and from where the dead body was thrown by the side of rail line was cited as witness in the case. PW 11 himself admitted in his cross-examination that except hotel boy, Dulal (not examined) and Md Kafiluddin (PW 3), none was examined of the place of occurrence. PW 8 stated in his cross-examination that “আমি যেখানে পানের দোকান করতাম তার কয়েকটি পান দোকান ছিল।” PW 11 also stated in his cross-examination that “জাহাদ হোটেলের সামনে কয়েকটি পান দোকান ছিল”)" but admittedly, no other pan shop owner except PW 8, was either cited in the charge sheet as witness or was examined in the case. PW 7 in his examination-in-chief categorically stated that he saw the dead body of the deceased lying 8 (eight) hands away on the East of the rail line by the side of the Continental Courier Service Limited, Mohakhali, Dhaka, but none of the said courier service was cited in the charge sheet as witness and was examined in Court. PW 11 also admitted that he did not examine any employee around the place of occurrence by the side of the rail line as indicted at mark 'ক' in the index prepared on 28-1-1997 (exhibit-'12'). The place marked as ও in exhibit-(1), i.e. the index is Mohakhali Music Center, marked 'ঙ' is a restaurant and marked 'ঝ' is Hotel-Al Noor, a residential Hotel. The PW further admitted that the dead body of the deceased was lying behind Hotel Al-Noor, but he has not cited anyone as witness from that hotel, he has not also cited any one as witness from the Continental Courier Service Ltd. At the risk of repetition, it is stated that the place where the dead body of the deceased was found was 8 (eight) hands away on the East of the rail line by the side of the office of the Continental Courier Service. Darwan was posted at New DOHS gate, he examined the Darwan, but did not record his statement. He did not examine the night guard of the place where the dead body was found. There were many shops on the way where the dead body was found. In the night, people might sleep in those shops, then said those people moved along that road, but none was either cited as witness in the charge sheet or examined in Court. 

 159. The most striking fact is that the Iftar party for which accused-Biddut called for the deceased was allegedly held at Jahad Hotel, but none from that hotel was cited as a witness in the case. PW 8 disclosed in his cross-examination that he told about the incident to hotel boy, Dulal 1/1½ months of the occurrence and though Dural was examined by PW 11 and cited as a witness, he was not examined in Court and no explanation was given for such non-examination by the prosecution. More interesting thing is that PW 11 himself admitted in his cross-examination that he examined the Manager of the hotel, but the Manager was not cited as a witness in the case. PW 2 has clearly stated that he .went to Jahad Hotel for buying Iftar, PW 3 stated that he went to Jahad Hotel to attend an If tar party, so it was the incumbent duty upon the Investigation Officer to investigation into whether any Par used to be sold in that hotel to the outsiders and whether Iftar parties at all used to be held in the hotel. This became more important in view of the suggestion given by the defence to PW 2 that no If tar used to be sold from that hotel and the positive evidence of DW1 that there is no arrangement for Iftar and no Iftar party was held in the Hotel on 27-1-1997. When PW 8 categorically stated, to PW 11 that after selling goods at his so-called pan shop, he used to sleep at Jahad Hotel and on the fateful night at 3 o'clock when he woke up from sleep for seheri and went at the rail line for urinating, he saw accused throwing a dead body. It became an imperative duty upon the Investigation Officer to inquire whether PW 8, in fact, at all used to sleep in the night in the hotel and whether there was any bathroom in the Hotel where he could urinate. But unfortunately, it does not appear from the charge sheet or the deposition of PW 11 that he ever directed his investigation in that direction. 

 160. No one has been examined to corroborate the prosecution case that Iftar used to be sold at Jahad Hotel, on the other hand, DW 1, Khokan Dutta, categorically stated that he is the Manager of Jahad Hotel since 1991; the hotel is a residential one, there is a restaurant at the ground floor of the hotel and there is no arrangement for If tar in the hotel and this assertion of DW 1 could not be negated by the prosecution by cross-examining him. That means the assertion made by him in his examination-in-chief remains intact, but unfortunately, the learned Judges of the High Court Division discarded the evidence of DW 1 by giving their own argument saying that "it is an unbelievable claim that during Ramadan the restaurant opens after sun set and Iftar food items are not on the menu of the hotel. DW 1 did not explain as to why Iftar food items are not on the menu on his hotel when according to him, it is a Muslim hotel, 14/15 boarders stay in the hotel everyday and in Dhaka, the fast observers eat their Iftar in hotels. So, the evidence of DW 1 is absurd and improbable which does not inspire confidence in our mind. Therefore, we hold the view that Iftar food items were undoubtedly prepared and sold in the restaurant of the Hotel at the relevant time and, as such, the prosecution story in this respect cannot be false." I wonder how the learned Judges of the High Court Division could demand explanation from DW 1 as to why Iftar food items were not in the menu of his hotel. A witness gives statements before a Court in relation to matters of facts under inquiry and he is not at all required to give any explanation in respect of a statement of a fact which he knows or within his knowledge; if the adverse party requires any explanation in respect of a statement made by a witness, it is they who are , to seek such explanation by cross-examinind him, but the prosecution did not seek any explanation from DW 1. So, DW 1 was not at all required to give any explanation whatsoever as observed by the learned Judges of the High Court Division. The finding of the High Court Division that the evidence of DW 1 in that regard is absurd and improbable is bereft of any reason, because it is the management of the Hotel who decides what shall be served in the Hotel or not. A Court could not ask why the Hotel authority did not keep Iftar food items on its menu, a Court would go by the evidence on record and not by its imagination. The High Court Division failed to consider that holding of Iftar party at Jahad Hotel, on 27-1-1997, was the most significant and important fact to connect the accused with the killing. Therefore, it was the duty of the prosecution to establish the said fact by examining competent witness at least from the neighbouring establishments that Iftar used to be sold at Jahad Hotel and Iftar party also used to be held there, instead the learned Judges found fault with DW 1, as to why he did not explain, why Iftar food items were not included "on the menu of his hotel."
